title: Network Core
summary: In-place WebSocket transport for authoritative rooms: single-threaded server on uWebSockets (epoll on Linux, libuv on Windows), a native client on libcurl's WebSocket, a browser client on the Emscripten WebSocket API, a bounded little-endian codec, and the HELLO version gate, message and queue limits, and rate limit every room shares.
dependencies: vendored uWebSockets v20.80.0 with uSockets (Apache-2.0) for the native server
vendored libuv v1.53.0 (MIT) for the native server on Windows
CURL::libcurl with WebSockets (NT_HTTP_WEBSOCKETS) for the native client
provides: nt::network_core CMake target (server + client natively, client on web)
nt::network_core_codec CMake target (codec only, every platform)
net_ws_server.h: net_ws_server_create/service/send/close, net_ws_server_take_stats workload counters, library versions
net_ws_client.h: net_ws_client_create/service/send on native and web
net_codec.h: bounded reader/writer, fixed-point grids and 16-bit headings, HELLO, NET_CLOSE_* codes

flags.runtime: none; the transport is compiled in wherever the target is linked
